run_bisection_timestamp_search: run a binary search to find the closest trajectory pose index for a given nanosecond timestamp
test_bisection_timestamp_search: test the bisection_timestamp_search function with a list of ClosedLoopTrajectoryPose objects and a query timestamp
review_bisection_timestamp_search: review the bisection_timestamp_search function for edge case handling when query timestamp is outside the data range

summarize_bisection_timestamp_search: summarize the bisection_timestamp_search function that performs binary search on sorted trajectory pose data by tracking timestamp
